description: HERO COMICS concept photos day 2: An Yujin and Jang Wonyoung. Martial-arts hero theme shot in a training center with comic hero posters on the walls, white walls with pastel pink and cyan symbols, HERO IVE TRAINING CENTER floor emblem. Yujin in a black outfit with purple hair accents strikes high-kick and training poses; Wonyoung with pink hair accents in matching combat styling; a combined shot of Yujin vs Wonyoung arm-wrestling. Playful fighter mood with vivid pink purple and cyan comic accents.
